privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.s1Body: Name, nickname, email address, phone number, date of birth, any allergies and dietary preferences, and for attendees under 18 the name and phone number of a guardian. We also store your tickets, seat choices, orders and payment references.
privacy.s2Body: To provide accounts, sell tickets and food, arrange seating, check age requirements and reach you and your guardian during the event. Allergy information is used by the kitchen.
privacy.s3Body: Payments are handled by Stripe. We never store your card details.
privacy.s4Body: Account data is kept for as long as you have an account. Accounting records (orders and payments) are kept for 7 years as required by Swedish bookkeeping law.
privacy.s5Body: You can download all data we hold about you and delete your account at any time under Profile. Deletion means anonymization: personal data is removed, while accounting records are kept without any link to you. You also have the right to complain to the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection (IMY).
privacy.s6Body: Send questions about how we process personal data to the association.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Answers to what we get asked most. Can't find yours – get in touch.
faq.q_howToBuy: How do I buy a ticket?
faq.a_howToBuy: Create an account and confirm your email address using the message we send. Then go to the event page, choose a ticket (and food and a seat if you like) and pay by card. Your ticket with its QR code appears under My pages and is also emailed to you.
faq.q_age: How old do I have to be?
faq.a_age: The age limit is {minAge}, calculated by year of birth: you can attend if you turn {minAge} at any point during the year the event is held. If you're under 18 you need to enter a guardian's name and phone number in your profile – only the organisers see them.
faq.q_refund: Can I cancel and get my money back?
faq.a_refund: Cancellations and refunds are handled by our organisers, not automatically. Get in touch and we'll help: {contact}. Include the order number from your receipt.
faq.q_hold: How long is my ticket reserved while I pay?
faq.a_hold: For 30 minutes. If you don't complete the payment in that time, the ticket and seat are released so others can buy them. Nothing is charged to your card if the payment didn't go through.
faq.q_code: I have a discount code – where do I use it?
faq.a_code: Enter the code in the "Do you have a discount code?" field in the purchase form on the event page. Some codes, for example for crew, also unlock ticket types that are otherwise hidden.
faq.q_forFriend: Can I buy a ticket for a friend?
faq.a_forFriend: No. A ticket belongs to whoever buys it, and everyone needs their own account – it's one ticket per person per event. Ask your friend to create an account and buy their own.
faq.q_vat: Why does it say the association isn't VAT-registered?
faq.a_vat: Cable connectors gaming society is a non-profit association that is not VAT-registered. That's why the receipt has no VAT breakdown.
faq.q_chooseSeat: How do I choose a seat?
faq.a_chooseSeat: You can choose a seat while buying (it is held for you while you pay) or afterwards on the event page. The map can also be used as a list, with filters and keyboard support, if you prefer.
faq.a_changeSeat: Yes, you can move to another free seat until the change deadline shown on the event page. Some ticket types are only valid in certain zones.
faq.a_food: Food packages can be bought together with your ticket or later on the event page, up to each package's order deadline. You choose a variant, for example vegetarian or vegan.
faq.q_allergies: How do my allergies reach the kitchen?
faq.a_allergies: Enter allergies and dietary preferences in your profile before ordering food. They are copied to your food order when you buy and shown to the kitchen and at pick-up.
faq.a_bring: Your computer and monitor, keyboard, mouse, headset, a network cable and an extension cord. Also read the event description on the event page for specific information, and don't forget something to sleep on if the event runs overnight.
faq.a_checkin: Show the QR code from My pages (or from the confirmation email) to the crew at the entrance. If you don't have your phone, giving your name or nickname usually works.
faq.q_minors: How does it work for attendees under 18?
faq.a_minors: Attendees under 18 need a guardian registered in their profile. At check-in the crew sees the guardian's name and phone number so they can be reached if needed.
faq.q_noMail: I didn't get a confirmation email.
faq.a_noMail: Check your spam folder. You can send a new confirmation email from the Profile page once you're logged in. You need to have confirmed your email to buy a ticket.
faq.q_data: What personal data do you store?
faq.a_data: Name, nickname, email, phone, date of birth, any allergies, guardian details for attendees under 18, and your orders. Read more in the privacy policy. You can download all your data at any time under Profile.
faq.q_delete: How do I delete my account?
faq.a_delete: You can delete your account under Profile. The account is anonymized: your personal data is removed, while orders and payments are kept without any link to you for seven years as required by Swedish bookkeeping law. If you have a ticket for an upcoming event, contact us to cancel it first.

crew.title: Join the crew
crew.lead: Our LANs are organised by members on a voluntary basis. The more of us there are, the more fun and safe it is – help for a while or the whole weekend.
crew.noEvent: We're looking for crew for our upcoming LANs.
crew.why1: You get a Crew ticket – no fee, we'll send you the code.
crew.why2: You learn useful things: networking, power, food for many, leading and teamwork.
crew.why3: You help decide what the LAN becomes.
crew.why4: You become part of a team of people who love the same thing as you.
crew.role_checkin_desc: You welcome guests at the entrance, scan tickets with the app, answer questions and hand out food. Great if you enjoy meeting people.
crew.role_kitchen_desc: You help prepare, serve and hand out meals and keep track of allergies and special diets.
crew.role_tech_desc: You build the network, run power and cables and troubleshoot when something breaks. We need both beginners and pros.
crew.role_hosts_desc: You make sure everyone is doing fine, walk around the venue, help with the rules and are there for younger attendees and their guardians.
crew.role_build_desc: You help get the venue ready beforehand and clean up and carry afterwards. No experience needed, just a strong back and good spirits.
crew.apply1: Email us at {email} and tell us who you are, which job interests you and when you can help.
crew.apply1NoMail: Contact the association and tell us who you are, which job interests you and when you can help.
crew.apply2: We'll get back to you and agree on the job and times.
crew.apply3: You'll receive a code that lets you get your Crew ticket on the event page. You need an account for that.
